decisions.reason: Replacing five tables does not change the requirement to include the organization chart.
The source changes table content but does not alter the fixed section order.
Message 88 concerns only replacement tables and does not change the biography count, affiliation, or population method.
The proposal must still package all required content into one document; replacing table versions does not change that requirement.
The table replacement does not change photo placement, source, or mandatory photo selection.
The source does not change the 34-page limit or state that the revised tables affect it.
Replacing tables from a linked document does not change the Blue Mesa brand identity or brand elements.
The revised table source does not modify the established font consistency rules.
The five revised tables must be integrated within the existing complete-document layout, but the layout requirement itself remains unchanged.
The source concerns current-proposal table replacement and does not resume or modify the deferred reusable modular template.
Replacing proposal tables does not change the required PDF count, format, email compatibility, or export quality.
The source does not change the requirement that proposal hyperlinks remain functional in the saved final file.
